_comment_baseUrl: No trailing slash, and no www -- this is the canonical origin every page declares. Every canonical, Open Graph URL, sitemap entry, schema @id and robots.txt line is built from it. Must match the CNAME file at the repo root.
_comment_shop: The Buy Fiesta call to action. One URL drives the nav item, the home hero button and the buy strip on every color page. Change it here and all three follow. Set url to an empty string and all three disappear -- nothing else needs touching.
_comment_googleSiteVerification: This token belongs to the old thekicker.github.io Search Console property and will NOT verify fiesta-color-guide.com. Either paste the token for the new property here, or verify the domain by DNS TXT record (which covers every subdomain and survives template changes) and set this to "".
_comment_content: Two separate dials, because the two page types fail differently. `minOriginalWords` withholds a COLOR page from the index until its description plus `notes` reach that many words; it is 0 by default because colour pages are distinct product pages that already earn search traffic, and withholding them costs impressions without helping anything. Raise it once notes are written and you want to enforce a floor. `requireShadeNotes` withholds a SHADE HUB until `shadeNotes` in fiesta.json has an entry for it -- those hubs are a filtered view of the homepage and have nothing original to say until you write it, so this defaults to true. Withheld pages are still built, linked and browsable; they just ship noindex,follow and stay out of sitemap.xml.
_comment_contact: Where the contact form posts. `netlify` emits Netlify Forms markup (data-netlify, honeypot, hidden form-name) and ONLY works if Netlify serves the site - on GitHub Pages the POST hits a 404 and the message is lost with no error. `action` posts to any absolute URL instead (Formspree, Web3Forms, Formspark) and works on any host; put the endpoint in `action`. `none` replaces the form with an email line. Change provider when the hosting changes, not before.
_comment_adsense: Two independent stages. Setting `client` puts the AdSense loader script and the google-adsense-account meta tag in the head of every page and writes ads.txt -- that is what site verification and Auto ads need, and it is all you need before approval. Filling in a `slots` entry additionally renders that manual <ins> unit in its reserved box; leave a slot empty and nothing is emitted for it. To turn everything off, clear `client`.
